name: Sberbank MegaData Center Balakovo
notes: DCD reported Sberbank's planned Saratov Oblast/Balakovo mega data center with more than 55,000 sqm, seven modules, at least 3,000 racks, about 120,000 servers, and estimated 82 MW at full build-out. DataCenterMap lists the Balakovo site at Shosse Metallurgov and describes completion targeted for 2027.

name: Rostelecom Saratov regional colocation offering
notes: Rostelecom's Saratov regional page offers colocation/data-center services through its Russian Tier III/Tier IV data-center network. The page confirms service availability for Saratov customers but does not publish a specific Saratov facility address or MW capacity.

name: Global Alania Data Center Kavkaz
notes: Connect-WIT described the Vladikavkaz Data Center Kavkaz project under the Ministry of Digital Development with planned Tier III design and first phase planned for Q1 2022. D-Russia/IKS reported Global Alania opened a regional data center in Vladikavkaz in 2020; NTSS reported in 2026 that the Kavkaz data center had recently opened and serves organizations in Alania and other North Caucasus regions. Public MW capacity not found.

Targeted searches found generic colocation/data-center service pages marketed to Smolensk customers, but no verifiable physical data-center facility or active construction project located in Smolensk Oblast with a published operator, address, or capacity.

name: Rostelecom Saint Petersburg-1 Data Center
notes: Rostelecom announced launch of a Tier III Saint Petersburg data center at ul. Zhukova 43 with 4,266 sqm total area, four machine halls, 800 racks, and 7,400 kW power capacity.

name: Selectel Tsvetochnaya 1 Data Center
notes: Selectel's official data-center page lists Tsvetochnaya 1 in Saint Petersburg with 679 sqm of server rooms, 227 racks, and 3 MW supplied power; official documentation provides the Saint Petersburg address.

name: Selectel Tsvetochnaya 2 Data Center
notes: Selectel's official page lists Tsvetochnaya 2 with 1,885 sqm of server rooms, 969 racks, and 10 MW supplied power; Selectel's 2015 launch article says the Tier III facility is in Saint Petersburg's Moskovsky district.

name: Goznak Saint Petersburg Data Processing Center
notes: Goznak announced opening of its data processing center at the Saint Petersburg Paper Mill on June 2, 2021, saying the Tier III-certified facility's six machine rooms host 470 racks. DataCenterMap lists 6 MW and 3,540 sqm at Fontanka River Embankment 144.

name: Linxdatacenter Saint Petersburg Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists Linxdatacenter's Saint Petersburg data center among certified facilities. Baxtel identifies Linxdatacenter Saint Petersburg as the largest Saint Petersburg facility at 12 MW and 96,875 sqft; Datacenters.com places it on Repishcheva Ulitsa 20 lit. A.

name: Rostelecom Stavropol Tier III Data Center
notes: Rostelecom announced industrial operation of a Stavropol data center in a purpose-built Tier III building for government and business customers. The source states 200 kW power, 24 rack spaces, diesel backup, reserved cooling, and PUE 1.3-1.5.

name: Key Point Yekaterinburg Data Center
notes: Key Point's official page lists its Yekaterinburg data center as operational, Tier III, carrier-neutral, with 880 IT racks and 6.2 MW IT power. Free Technologies' project page says the CRAFT Industrial Park facility launched in March 2026 and has 11 MW total design capacity.

name: MegaFon Yekaterinburg Data Center
notes: DCD and AK&M reported MegaFon launched new data centers in Yekaterinburg and Tver; each is around 800 sqm, accommodates 110 racks, and offers 1 MW server equipment load with high-load racks allowing up to 1.5 MW.

name: Rostelecom Yekaterinburg-1 Data Center
notes: CNews reported RTK-DC would build the second phase of Rostelecom's Yekaterinburg facility: 216 additional racks and 2 MW, matching the existing 216 racks and 2 MW then in operation. TAdviser records later third-phase activity; public detail suggests at least 4 MW after phase two.

name: Datahouse Yekaterinburg Data Center
notes: Datahouse's official Yekaterinburg page describes a carrier-neutral data center with 52 racks in four machine halls. AllDC lists the DataHouse Ekt facility as commercially operational since November 2012 with 0.8 MW maximum power.

name: Atomdata Innopolis Data Center
notes: Atomdata's official Innopolis page identifies the Tatarstan facility. Interfax reported Rosatom launched the first stage: the full data center is designed for 16 MW, 2,000 racks, and more than 23,000 sqm in two buildings; the first stage has 1,000 rack spaces.

name: Kazan IT Park Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Kazan IT Park Data Center at Peterburgskaya 52, Kazan, Tatarstan, operated by Kazan Hi-Technology Park IT Park. Telecombloger's Kazan catalog also lists IT Park as a Kazan data center. Public MW capacity not found.

name: Stack Kazan Data Center
notes: Colocation marketplace and local directory listings identify Stack Kazan as a data center at Orenburgskiy Trakt 5/5D in Kazan. Capacity not published in reliable public sources found.

Targeted searches for Tambov/Tambov Oblast data center, datacenter, server farm, colocation, Ростелеком, МТС, МегаФон, ЦОД and центр обработки данных found no verifiable physical data-center facility or announced project in Tambov Oblast.

name: NetPoint Tomsk Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists NetPoint Datacenter at Ulitsa Shishkova 13A, 2nd floor, Tomsk, offering hosting/colocation services. Rostelecom also markets data-center services to Tomsk customers, but no separate Tomsk physical Rostelecom facility capacity was verified.

name: MTS planned Tula data center
notes: DCD reported MTS created a data-center subsidiary and planned four new data centers through 2024, including Tula, Rostov, Yekaterinburg, and Khabarovsk. Later DCD coverage of MTS's Novosibirsk modular site repeated Tula as one of the planned regional locations. No reliable public completion or MW capacity found for the Tula site.

name: Rostelecom Tula data-center services office / legacy listing
notes: Rostelecom markets data-center services to Tula customers. A Yandex Maps listing identifies 'Rostelecom, data processing centers' at Sovetskaya Street 67, office 402, but marks it shut down; this may be an office or legacy service point rather than a physical data hall. No MW capacity verified.
